text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki and I have come to the
shopping
district to buy some daily
necessities when we
spot a throng of
people ahead of us.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It appears something is happening up
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah, a raffle.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello there. Are you two heading
home?
Before you do, you wouldn't
happen to have a
raffle ticket on you,
would you?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
A raffle ticket? As a matter of fact, I do.
I
received one earlier.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Great! Come on over, then!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I wouldn't want the ticket go to
waste,
but...
choice_data_list: せっかくだから引いてきなよ！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When I was a child, I once destroyed a
raffle
machine in a fit of rage because I
couldn't accept
the results.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I was forbidden from entering
any
more local raffles.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm still unaccustomed to them,
I'm... quite
nervous about how I'll react!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please, won't you turn the lever with
me?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You have my thanks. Now, then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki and I give the raffle
machine a
gentle spin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HNGH! ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How fortuitous.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I will not! There's no greater mark of
immaturity
than being swept up in
emotion.
choice_data_list: いやいやいや！もっと喜ぼう！？

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I must remain composed at all times!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that as long as she doesn't go
running
around wildly or something, it's
fine to show as
much happiness as she
wants.
choice_data_list: 喜びを抑える必要はないよ！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I-is that so? So it's all right for me to let
loose this
delight I'm feeling?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let's!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HURRAAAY!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'd like for you to use this coupon.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I've been observing you as you walk and
noticed
that your movements are a bit
rigid, especially in
the neck, shoulders,
and lower back.
choice_data_list: えっ？でも、君の福引券だし……
えっ？でも、貴方の福引券だし……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I suspect you're suffering from stiff
muscles, in
which case I recommend
going to a hot spring to
recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's right. My shoulders and back do feel stiff, but when I point out that she must be tired as well...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. I'm the picture of health.
Thanks to
your guidance, nary a trace of
fatigue lingers
within my body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd even argue it's especially important
for
someone like Yaeno Muteki, who
keeps herself to
such militantly high
standards, to take breaks.
choice_data_list: だけど、リフレッシュも必要だ
だけど、リフレッシュも必要だよ

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... training at a hot spring might be
a
refreshing change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, the coupon's for two, so
how about
this?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Once our schedule opens up, why don't
we both
go together?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Then it's decided. I shall leave the
coupon in your
care.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. I can hardly wait.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Yaeno Muteki and I make a fun
plan to
look forward to!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Th-this carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Rice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: We need rice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I've had this hamburger steak before
back at
home. Someone gave one to my
family as a
year-end gift.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The succulent demi-glace sauce goes

exceptionally well with rice! We refilled
our bowls
so quickly, we ran out of rice
before we knew it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It won't suffice to bring back this deluxe
carrot
hamburger steak on its own.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let's buy some rice and hurry back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At Yaeno Muteki's request, we go buy a
bag of
rice before heading home.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Munch, munch, munch.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it wonderful? What can you call this

combination of deluxe carrot hamburger
steak
and rice if not pure bliss?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Long live demi-glace sauce!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Yaeno Muteki, I get the
chance to
delight in the ultimate pairing
of deluxe carrot
hamburger steak and
rice!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What?! That's so many!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
By no means can we finish all these with
just the
two of us.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me for pressing such a silly
question upon
you, but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm unfamiliar with the details of
how
friendships work, there's something
I'd like to
confirm with you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Would it be considered rude to offer my

classmates food made with these
carrots?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then I think I'll prepare some
dishes for
Chiyono O and Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Mmm! That was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the home-cooked carrot
feast, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Everything was delectable. I particularly
liked the
refreshing taste of the carrot
rice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...!
I... I'm glad you both enjoyed the
meal.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Carrots are highly nutritious, so when I
came into
possession of a wealth of
carrots, I immediately
thought of you
two.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I know it was presumptuous, but I hope
you'll
forgive me for showing up
suddenly with so many.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... You have nothing to apologize
for,
Yaeno. Thank you so much for this.
Hehehe. I'm
so glad you think so dearly
of us.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Same! That's precisely what they mean
when they
say, "Show humanity to your
enemy and a carrot
to your rival!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm? Why do I feel like I've heard
something
similar before?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Interesting proverb aside, Yaeno Muteki
seems
more than pleased that the two
enjoyed the
carrot dishes she made.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hmm, a single carrot...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll pickle this. Pickles are great
for
replenishing one's sodium levels, and
are perfect
for snacking on during
breaks between training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
They make a good lunch served with rice
balls as
well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So it is, if I do say so myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
One look at this carrot's luster was
enough to
convince me to pickle it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to try some once it's
ready? I'll
bring it to our next training
session.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Yaeno Muteki and I have
the
pickled carrot. It's delightful, with
just the right
amount of salt!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I see. This must have been a test.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Were you not testing to see if I
would be
able to calmly accept even the
bitterest of raffle
outcomes?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
What?! Why would I even consider doing
such a
thing?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You needn't try to hide the truth. I
know I
am merely reaping what I sowed
long, long ago.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you how capable I am of
enduring this
humiliating outcome with
full composure!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Tissues... What more perfect and
universally
utilitarian a prize could one
ask for?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Heh... Behold! I was able to transform a single raffle ticket into this much paper!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If that isn't the definition of good
fortune, then
what is? Not only that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say Yaeno Muteki is perfectly

composed, but she manages to stay
reasonably
calm, showing only a hint of
disappointment.
